name: Messaben Corp.
summary: Messaben Corp. offers innovative technological solutions across the geothermal, oil, and gas sectors. These offerings encompass critical areas such as water sustainability initiatives, the comprehensive treatment and reclamation of produced water, and specialized downhole metal intervention products. The company, which previously operated as China Electronics Holdings, Inc., officially rebranded to Messaben Corp. in April 2022. Its corporate headquarters are situated in New York, New York.
